structured_intent.editorial_meaning: The animation emphasizes how a compact apartment can feel open, bright, and comfortably zoned for separate activities.
structured_intent.initial_state: The sleeping area is visible on the left and the dining zone on the right, separated by a foreground floor-to-ceiling timber divider.
structured_intent.primary_action: The viewpoint translates rightward across the open-plan room.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The timber divider appears farther left in the frame and slightly more of the already visible dining zone is revealed.
structured_intent.geometry_invariant: The timber divider remains rigidly connected between the floor and ceiling while separating the sleeping and dining zones.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The apartment remains a spacious, practical, and light-preserving example of personalized zoning.
